title: Expansion playbook: Growth paths for Dedicated, Private, and SLA
content:
Purpose
---
This is a working playbook for Customer Success reps to drive expansion (Dedicated capacity upsells, Private deployments, Premium SLA add-ons). Focus is on repeatable signals, an operational cadence (QBR + renewal tracker), templated messaging, and a technical runbook for engineering handoffs. This doc intentionally mixes polished sections and quick notes for field use — copy into account-specific playbooks.

Target segments and triggers
---
- Mid-market / high-usage SaaS customers (20k+ tokens/day; spike patterns) => Dedicated upsell candidate.
- Regulated verticals (healthcare, finance, govt) or customers with strict VPC/HSM needs => Private deployment.
- Customers with strict uptime/latency SLOs or legal continuity requirements => Premium SLA.

Signals (priority order)
- Sustained 30% month-over-month token growth for 3 months.
- Error spike / throttling incidents > 1/week or recurring cold-start latency issues.
- Security/compliance request tracked in sales or legal (NDA, SOC2 boundary requests, KMS/HSM).
- Architecture review asks for dedicated capacity sizing or on-prem proofs.
- Contract renewal within 90–180 days and usage trending above current commit.

Play stages (one-line summary + owner)
---
1) Discovery (CSM) — collect signals, initial business case, priority: time-to-value and cost.
2) Technical deep-dive (Solutions Eng + Infra) — baseline perf tests, network/topology checklist, KPI targets.
3) Commercial framing (CSM + Account Exec) — committed throughput, price ladder, term options.
4) Pilot / PoC (SE + Infra + Customer) — 2–6 week pilot for Private/Dedicated scale validation.
5) Rollout & migration (PM + Infra + CS) — cutover plan, rollback, post-migration QBR.
6) Expansion close & onboarding (CS) — success plan, SLO handoff, billing amendment.

Dedicated upgrade playbook (notes + checklist)
---
Quick thesis: move customers from shared hosted to Dedicated when the marginal cost + reliability benefit outweighs price.
Checklist:
- Gather 90-day usage histogram (tokens/day, p95 latency, peak qps).
- Run cost-sensitivity model: show current unit cost vs committed Dedicated pricing at target capacity. (attach spreadsheet)
- Identify peak windows and whether autoscaling/burst solves short spikes vs committed capacity.
- Map required GPU class (A100 80GB vs A10s) and expected throughput.
- Confirm data isolation needs and legal prefs.
- Prepare canary migration steps: route X% traffic, monitor KV cache hit rate, p50/p95 latency, and error rate.
- SE checklist for model variants and quantization changes.

Private deployment playbook (notes + friction points)
---
Thesis: For customers with compliance/regulatory constraints or networking isolation needs. Emphasize security, auditability, and cloud/offline options.
Key prep:
- Network prep: list of required egress rules, IP allowlists, VPN tunnels.
- KMS/HSM integration plan (who to coordinate with on customer side).
- Data residency and retention policy mapping.
- Ops model: support handoff windows, monitoring endpoints (SNMP/Prometheus), and alerting runbooks.
- Migration risks: latency differences, hardware parity, model quantization regressions.

Premium SLA add-on playbook
---
Offer when customers require contractual SLOs (99.9%+, low p99 latency) or indemnities.
Pricing considerations: higher unit price + minimum committed capacity. Include:
- SLO definition draft (uptime, p99/p95 latency, error budget policy).
- Penalty/credit template.
- Runbook for incident response (page owner, escalation path, RTO/RPO).

QBR template (CSM use)
---
- Attendees: CSM, Customer Eng lead, Product/Infra rep (optional), Customer PM/Eng.
- Duration: 45–60m for expansion conversations.
- Agenda: 1) Quick health snapshot (usage, top routes, tokens by endpoint) 2) Incidents & SLA performance 3) Cost & committed capacity review 4) Product roadmap / model changes 5) Expansion proposal & next steps 6) Open items / decision calendar.
- Metrics to include (copy/paste into slides):
  - 90-day token trend (total + by route)
  - p50/p95/p99 latency trends by route
  - Error rate (5xx / total requests) and root-cause notes
  - Cost per 1k tokens (current vs proposed Dedicated/Private)
  - Hit rate: cache / prefix / KV savings (if used)
  - Time-to-first-byte for cold starts
- Example slide bullets for expansion ask: "Move to Dedicated N GPUs to reduce p95 latency from Xms to Yms and decrease unit cost by Z% at committed levels."

Tactical messaging (email snippets)
---
- Intro outreach (short): "Hi <Name>, noticed sustained usage growth and a number of peak windows — I think Dedicated capacity could lower latency and your unit cost. Can we book 30 minutes to review numbers and a potential pilot? — Marisol"
- Technical handoff: "SEs — attaching perf histogram and p95 latency with current routing. Request: whiteboard pilot sizing for 2-week dedicated pilot. Key success metric: p95 < target and <1% errors."

Technical handoff template (SE -> Infra -> Customer)
---
- Attach: last 90d usage histogram, sample trace showing cold start, preferred model variants, quantization notes, peak qps expectations, target SLOs, contact list for customer infra.
- Required infra answers from customer: allowed egress, IP ranges, KMS vendor, SOC2 control owner.

Collateral & assets to attach
---
- Dedicated pricing matrix (internal spreadsheet link).
- Private deployment checklist (confluence link).
- SLA terms playbook (legal template draft).
- Pilot runbook (github repo PR referenced above).

Risks & mitigation (quick list)
---
- Regression from quantization: run A/B on small percentage and keep fallback to hosted variant.
- Network misconfig: run a pre-cutover connectivity test checklist and a dry-run with customer VPN.
- Billing disputes: include clear commit tiers and measurement windows in amendment.

Operational TODOs (short)
---
- [ ] Create Dedicated ROI one-pager per SM account (CS owners)
- [ ] Build a short pilot template (SE + Infra) that can be run in 5 days
- [ ] Legal to finalize SLA credit table (ask legal: Priya)
- [ ] Product to prepare short list of model variants certified for Dedicated/Private (ask product: Jonah)

Open questions / decisions needed
---
- How aggressive should discounting be when customer commits 6 vs 12 months? (pricing ops)
- Do we require a minimum Dedicated commit baseline for SLA eligibility?
- Template for rollback window length after cutover (1 week vs 30 days?)

Notes to self / scratchpad (choppy brainstorm)
---
- consider bundling observability retention + premium SLA as a "Reliability Pack"
- capture a few customer stories (internal) to use as social proof in QBRs — ask CS to flag wins
- idea: automated renewal nudges when 30-day avg usage > 120% of commit

Appendix: sample QBR slide checklist (copy into slide deck)
---
1) Title / attendees / date
2) Health metric scoreboard (tokens, latency, errors, cost)
3) Top 3 wins since last QBR
4) Current asks (list) + impact table (latency / cost / reliability)
5) Proposed plan & timeline (pilot -> migrate -> measure -> close)
6) Decisions required & owners
7) Parking lot / next meetings

If you copy this into Confluence, use the page id linked above and change status to in_review after the first account run.

End of doc — quick notes: keep this short in slides, detailed in playbook.
